long.title: How to Whiten Yellowed White Clothes (Don't Throw That Shirt Away)
long.description:
Yellow stains on your white clothes? In this step-by-step video you'll learn how to whiten yellowed white clothes without harsh chlorine bleach: check the label and sort, pretreat underarm stains with dish soap and baking soda, soak with baking soda, try an oxygen booster soak, wash on a warm cycle, dry in the sun, and prevent yellowing in the future. Safe for cotton and polyester whites.

You'll need: baking soda, white vinegar, oxygen booster powder, liquid dish soap, a large bucket or sink.

WikiTube publishes a new step-by-step how-to video every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next one.

Apto para algodón y poliéster blanco.

it.description:

Per cotone e poliestere bianco.

id.title: Cara Memutihkan Pakaian Putih yang Menguning (Tanpa Pemutih Keras)
id.description:

Dalam video langkah demi langkah ini, Anda akan belajar memutihkan pakaian putih yang menguning tanpa pemutih klorin yang keras: baca label dan pilah, perlakukan noda keringat dengan sabun cuci piring dan baking soda, rendam dengan baking soda, coba rendaman pemutih oksigen, cuci dengan siklus hangat, jemur di bawah matahari, dan cegah menguning kembali. Aman untuk katun dan poliester putih.
